baseline.scope: working tree snapshot at the start of the temporary-file cleanup and kernel-arithmetic task, including the earlier LiteGS-style JAX/NNX interface changes and uint8 target loading

changes: Reduce the maximum absolute image gradient in the loss kernel while writing each tile; packed training reuses the floored scale.
Use the upper half of the first vertical pixel pair for both linear and quadratic moments at offsets (0, 1).
Pack horizontal half sums with half2 instructions instead of half-to-float and float-to-half conversions.
